title: Medical Billing Expert Enhances Solutions for Healthcare Providers Nationwide
text:
One Source Medical Billing (OSMB) is fast gaining popularity for assisting healthcare organizations in the United States with its all-inclusive service optimizing income, lowering claim denials, enhancing collections, and taking back control of their financial situation.
Launched with the goal to streamline the billing process and boost medical practice profitability, One Source Medical Billing now also provides medical coding, insurance verification, credentialing, and complete revenue cycle management (RCM) services customized for a broad spectrum of healthcare institutions—from clinics and hospitals to urgent care centers, DME providers, and mental health practices.
Solving Healthcare’s Most Expensive Billing Mistakes
“The most expensive billing mistake? Thinking you’re not making one,” says Kris Ramac, spokesperson for One Source Medical Billing. “Every missed code, every denied claim, and every delay in verification is money left on the table. We’re here to stop that.”
OSMB’s Facebook community highlights the real financial struggles faced by healthcare providers—from lost revenue due to preventable claim denials to inefficient in-house billing processes that result in inconsistent cash flow.
A Full-Service Medical Billing Partner
One Source Medical Billing is not just a billing company—it is a full-service revenue and reimbursement consulting partner. Clients benefit from:
-
90%+ First Pass Clean Claim Rate
-
8–15 Days Claim Turnaround Time
-
15–25% Increase in Revenue
-
95%+ Collection Rate
-
25–30% Decrease in Accounts Receivable
-
30–35 Net Days in AR
“Our clients typically experience increased revenue, faster reimbursements, and fewer administrative burdens,” Ramac added. “We give providers the ability to focus on what they do best—caring for patients—while we handle the rest.”
Customized RCM and Billing Solutions
At OSMB, customized solutions are at the heart of every engagement. From solo physicians and growing multi-specialty groups to an established hospital network, the team at OSMB works closely with its clients to:
-
Optimize the revenue cycle from patient scheduling to final payment
-
Ensure proper insurance verification before services are rendered
-
Assign accurate CPT/HCPCS billing codes and ICD-10 diagnosis codes
-
Manage the entire claims lifecycle—from creation and submission to appeals and collections
-
Deliver detailed performance reports that reveal revenue leaks and areas for growth
Clients also receive support in physician credentialing, record indexing, medical transcription, and compliance documentation, making OSMB a one-stop solution for operational efficiency.
Benefits for Healthcare Providers
In-house billing teams can be expensive, overburdened, and prone to errors—especially when staff are not fully trained on evolving billing codes and payer regulations. Outsourcing to One Source Medical Billing means tapping into a team of highly trained professionals who stay up to date with the latest regulatory and compliance requirements.
Benefits of outsourcing with OSMB include:
-
Lower overhead costs
-
Fewer billing and coding errors
-
Steady cash flow and faster claim processing
-
Reduced burden on clinical staff
-
Enhanced patient satisfaction through faster billing resolutions
“Providers often think they’re saving money by keeping billing in-house,” said Ramac. “But when claims are denied or delayed, they end up losing thousands in revenue. Our goal is to prevent that loss and ensure providers are paid fully and on time.”
Serving Healthcare Providers Coast to Coast
OSMB proudly serves medical providers in major cities across the U.S., including Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, Phoenix, New York, San Diego, Miami and San Antonio.
Its clients span a wide spectrum of specialties, such as:
-
Primary and Specialty Care Clinics
-
Mental and Behavioral Health Providers
-
Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Suppliers
-
Radiology and Imaging Centers
-
Physical and Occupational Therapy Practices
-
Laboratories and Ambulatory Surgery Centers
-
Home Health and Hospice Agencies
Free Consultations and Transparent Pricing
To encourage healthcare providers to explore smarter billing options, OSMB offers free consultations and custom-tailored assessments. Interested clinics and practitioners can visit www.onesourcemedicalbilling.com or call 888-624-5563 to speak directly with a billing expert.
OSMB’s transparent pricing model ensures clients pay based on collected revenue, aligning their success with the success of the providers they serve.
For any inquiries, contact Kris Ramac at kris@onesourcemedicalbilling.com
